reviewer: /root/training_audit (assistant; also author of these development cases)
review_scope: Every actual input/output pair in the complete 80-case report was read in four untruncated 20-case batches; judgments use meaning and direct usability, not expected-string equality.
limitations: Authored synthetic development diagnostics; same assistant author/judge; not blinded, not independent human review and not a population accuracy estimate.
policy: Fixed conservative preservation policy. Meaning-changing outputs are not directly usable. Unprotected stray leading whitespace fails cleanliness; discretionary valid punctuation and unprotected apostrophe typography can pass. Critical errors identify lost object/source facts, action conditions or newly activated actions, separately from precision/emphasis-only losses.
